atoms.evidence: Labor Notes is an American media and organizing project
founded in 1979 by labor activist Kim Moody
it reports on rank-and-file union democracy, strikes, and independent worker-led organizing efforts.
Publishes 11 issues annually covering shop-floor strategy, union elections, and grassroots campaigns across major sectors.
Operating as a voice for the "troublemaking wing" of the labor movement
